description: [Egypt] Rail Transport Routes is a data set listed in Transport Data Commons (Transport Data Catalogue), a transport data catalogue, published or maintained by Transport for Cairo. This dataset represents existing and planned rail transport projects in Cairo, Egypt. It includes the geometry of current and future corridors for the Cairo Metro, Light Rail Transit (LRT), Monorail, and High-Speed Rail (HSR) systems. The dataset covers operational lines, under-construction projects, and proposed extensions within the Greater Cairo Region. Coverage: Egypt. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for Cairo. Its tags are Cairo, Egypt, Greater Cairo Region, High-speed Rail, Metro. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEOJSON, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tdc-portal.
